question: Please calculate the race completion percentage of Japanese drivers from 2007 to 2009.
evidence: from 2007 to 2009 refers to year between 2007 and 2009; race completion refers to time is not null; percentage = Divide(COUNT(DriverID where time is not null and year between 2007 and 2009),Count (DriverID where year between 2007 and 2009))*100;
clarification: Count each distinct raceId only once.
gold: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(NOT T1.time IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.raceId) FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T1.driverId = T3.driverId WHERE T3.nationality = 'Japanese' AND T2.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009
gold0: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.time IS NOT NULL, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.raceId) FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 on T1.raceId = T2.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 on T1.driverId = T3.driverId WHERE T3.nationality = 'Japanese' AND T2.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009

c.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.time IS NOT NULL THEN r.raceId END) / COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) AS completion_percentage FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE d.nationality = 'Japanese' AND ra.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009

b.request: Calculate the percentage of results entries for Japanese drivers in races from 2007 to 2009 with a non-null finish time, relative to all their results entries in those years, counting each distinct raceId only once (i.e., COUNT(DISTINCT raceId) with time not null divided by COUNT(DISTINCT raceId) overall, times 100)
b.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.time IS NOT NULL THEN r.raceId END) / COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) AS percentage FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE d.nationality = 'Japanese' AND ra.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009

d.request: Please calculate the race completion percentage of Japanese drivers from 2007 to 2009, counting each distinct raceId only once. Race completion means the time is not null, and the percentage is the number of distinct races in which Japanese drivers completed (time is not null) between 2007 and 2009, divided by the number of distinct races in which Japanese drivers took part between 2007 and 2009, multiplied by 100.
d.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.time IS NOT NULL THEN r.raceId END) / COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) AS completion_percentage FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE d.nationality = 'Japanese' AND ra.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009
